name: ghostqa
description: Adaptive web behavior testing platform for real-world user and failure scenarios.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,dashboard "npm run dev --workspace @ghostqa/server" "npm run dev --workspace @ghostqa/dashboard"
scripts.demo:baseline: npm run build --workspace @ghostqa/shared --workspace @ghostqa/test-engine && npm run baseline --workspace @ghostqa/demo-target
scripts.demo:test:smoke: npm run build --workspace @ghostqa/shared --workspace @ghostqa/test-engine && npm run test:smoke --workspace @ghostqa/demo-target
scripts.demo:scenarios: npm run build --workspace @ghostqa/shared --workspace @ghostqa/test-engine && npm run scenarios --workspace @ghostqa/demo-target
scripts.demo:test:scenarios: npm run build --workspace @ghostqa/shared --workspace @ghostqa/test-engine && npm run test:scenarios --workspace @ghostqa/demo-target
scripts.demo:seed: npm run build --workspace @ghostqa/shared --workspace @ghostqa/test-engine --workspace @ghostqa/server && npm run seed --workspace @ghostqa/demo-target
scripts.demo:persisted-run: npm run build --workspace @ghostqa/shared --workspace @ghostqa/test-engine --workspace @ghostqa/server && npm run persisted-run --workspace @ghostqa/demo-target
scripts.demo:test:persisted-run: npm run build --workspace @ghostqa/shared --workspace @ghostqa/test-engine --workspace @ghostqa/server && npm run test:persisted-run --workspace @ghostqa/demo-target
